title: Quintessential Norwegian Prosciutto Soup
description: A light, nutty Norwegian soup that balances the savory depth of prosciutto with the earthy complexity of miso and toasted almonds, served hot from a traditional donabe.
instructions: Heat the donabe over medium heat and add the water to create a gentle simmer.
Add the prosciutto slices, letting them soften for about 5 minutes while releasing flavor into the broth.
Stir in the miso paste and soy sauce until evenly dissolved.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and sliced leek, cooking until the vegetables become translucent, about 7 minutes.
Fold in the toasted almond flakes, seaweed sheet, and a pinch of salt, simmering for another 5 minutes until the seaweed is tender.
Taste the soup and adjust seasoning with more salt or soy sauce if desired.
Turn off the heat, ladle the soup into a bowl, and serve hot from the donabe.
Finish with a sprinkle of fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil if desired.
